name: nexus-mission-control
description: NEXUS Mission Control — one command center for your entire software delivery lifecycle.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nexus/types && npm run build -w @nexus/utils
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexus/api" "npm run dev -w @nexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.seed: npm run build:packages && npm run seed -w @nexus/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/web
scripts.lint: tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/utils/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @nexus/api && npm run test -w @nexus/web
